book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Da AntapGod i gibe niu neim po Abram
Wen Abram bin kese 99 iya oul, da AntapGod i bin kam ane soe emselp po em. Da AntapGod i bin spik po em, ‘Ai da Strong AntapGod. Yu mas meke ebriting wea i rait prant lo mi ane no meke eni nugudting.
Ane ai go go ane meke strong griment wea yu ane ai go gibe yu prapa plenti pamlelain.’
Den Abram bin poldaun, pesdaun tase graun, ane God bin spik,
‘Ai meke dis strong griment wea yu. Yu gobi prapa bigate blo ol prapa plenti pipol uda stap wea dempla oun kantri.
Nomo nau neim blo yu gobi Abram. Ai go kole yu Eibram
nau bikoz ai bin meke yu bigate blo ol prapa plenti pipol uda stap wea dempla oun kantri.
Ai go gibe yu plenti pamlelain. Ol pamlelain blo yu i go kam plenti dipren dipren pipol, uda tok dempla oun langus ane stap wea dempla oun kantri, ane ol king i go kamaut prom yu.

‘Ai go meke strong griment wea yu. I gobi melen mi ane yu, ol pamlelain blo yu uda i bon apta yu, ane pamlelain apta pamlelain godaun. Dis strong griment i go mata go poeba. Ai God blo yu, ane God blo pamlelain blo yu uda i go bon apta yu.
Ai go gibe dis lan po yu, ane po ol pamlelain blo yu. Ebridem lan blo Kanan i gobi blo yupla pamlelain poeba, ane ai gobi God blo dempla.’
Sain blo strong griment wanem God mekem wea Eibram
God i bin kip spik po Eibram, ‘Da pat blo yu, yu mas pole dis strong griment blo mi, yu ane da pamlelain blo yu, pamlelain apta pamlelain go nau.
Diswan da strong griment blo mi wea yupla mas mekem, melen mi ane yu, ane pamlelain blo yu uda kam apta yu: ebri boi pikinini lo pamlelain blo yu mas kate poskin.
Yupla mas mekem wanem ai spik po yupla. Diswan gobi sain blo da strong griment melen mi ane yupla.

Pamlelain apta pamlelain blo yupla, ebri boi pikinini prom yupla mas kate poskin wen dempla i kese da namba eit dei apta dempla bon. Ebridem boi pikinini uda bin bon insaid wea pamle blo yu, yu mas kate poskin blo dempla. Ebridem boi pikinini uda bin bon prom sebant blo yu, yu mas kate poskin blo dempla. Ane ebridem boi pikinini wea i bin baiem wea mani prom ausaid man, dempla tu, mas kate poskin blo dempla.

Ebridem boi pikinini uda i bon insaid lo pamle blo yupla, ebridem boi pikinini uda i bon prom sebant blo yupla, ane ol dem nadawan yupla baiem wea mani, yupla mas kate da poskin blo dempla. Diswan gobi sain wea bodi blo yupla blo dis strong griment ai bin mekem wea yupla ane dis strong griment i go mata go poeba.
Eni man pikinini uda no kate poskin blo dempla, dat man i nomo gobi man blo mi bikoz em no bin pole da strong griment blo mi.’
Da AntapGod gibe niu neim po Sarai
God bin kip spik po Eibram, ‘Sarai oman blo yu, yu nomo go kolem Sarai. Neim blo em gobi Sera nau.

Ai go blese em ane ai go gibe yu wan boi pikinini prom em. Wa. Da boi pikinini gobi prapa bigate blo plenti dipren pipol wea ol stap lo dempla oun kantri, ane ol king i go kamaut prom ol pamlelain blo em.’

Den Eibram bin nildaun, pes blo em tase da graun, ane em bin lap ane tingk po emselp, ‘Sa! Wiskain man diswan i go gad pikinini wen em i kese 100 iya oul? Wiskain Sera diswan i go bone pikinini wen em i kese 90 iya oul?’
Ane Eibram spik po God, ‘Yagar! Mata lugaut boi blo mi, Ismaiel gar, ane mata meke gudsamting po em.’
God ansarem, ‘Nono! Sera, oman blo yu, i go bon wan boi pikinini, ane yu go kolem Aizak.
Ai go meke strong griment wea em solong da strong griment go mata go poeba po pamlelain blo em ane uda i go bon apta em.

Bat po Ismaiel, ai bin lisen wanem yu wande mi po mekem po em. Tru gar! Ai go blese em ane gibe em prapa plenti pikinini ane prapa plenti pamlelain. Em i go kam bigate blo tuelb prapa impotant man uda go kamaut prom pamlelain blo Ismaiel.
Bat ai go meke strong griment wea Aizak. Prom Sera ane yu, dis boi i gobi bon distaim neks iya.’
Wen God bin pinis tok po Eibram, God bin libe em ane go.

Wa. Dat seimdei Eibram bin mekem wanem God bin wandem. Em bin kate poskin blo Ismaiel ane ebridem man uda i bon insaid lo pamle blo em, ebridem man uda i bon prom sebant blo em, ane ol dem nadawan em bin baiem wea mani.
Poskin blo demtu Eibram ane Ismaiel i bin kat lo seimdei. Eibram nau i bin 99 iya oul, ane Ismaiel i bin 13 iya oul.
Ane poskin blo ebridem man sebant ane boi blo dem sebant blo Eibram, ane ebridem man ane boi uda Eibram bin baiem wea mani, bin kat tu wea dat dei.

footnotes.text: Eibram wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol i min ‘bigate blo tumas dipren pipol’.
Sera wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol i min ‘gel blo bos blo wan biliz’.
Aizak wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol i min ‘em lap’.
